chapter.heading: Psalm 58
God Who Judges the Earth
To the choirmaster: according to Do Not Destroy. A Miktam(1) of David.
chapter.v: Do you judge the children of man uprightly?
they go astray from birth, speaking lies.
like the deaf adder that stops its ear,
tear out the fangs of the young lions, O Lord !
aims his arrows, let them be blunted.
the stillborn child who never sees the sun.
bathe his feet in the blood of the wicked.

footnotes.footnote: 58:1 Probably a musical or liturgical term
58:1 Or *you mighty lords* (by revocalization; Hebrew *in silence*)
58:9 The meaning of the Hebrew verse is uncertain
